Entry requirements
Admission criteria
For admission to a Doctor of Philosophy degree, you will need to have completed either (or equivalent to):
A Master degree by research (AQF level 9); or
A Master degree by coursework (AQF level 9) or Master degree extended (AQF level 9) with weighted average mark (WAM) of ≥ 65 or a seven-point GPA of 5.0 or higher, incorporating at least 0.5 years full time (or part time equivalent) of research training* with a WAM of ≥ 75 or a seven-point GPA of 6.0 or higher; or
A 4-year Bachelor (Honours) (AQF level 8) or Graduate Diploma (AQF level 8) (following a bachelor or honours degree) with an overall WAM of ≥ 65 or a seven-point GPA of 5.0 or higher, incorporating at least 0.5 years full time (or part time equivalent) of research training* with a WAM of ≥ 75 or a seven-point GPA of 6.0 or higher; or
A Graduate Certificate (Research Skills) (AQF level 8) with an overall WAM of ≥ 75 or a seven-point GPA of 6.0 or higher, with approved professional experience; or
An equivalent combination of qualifications and experience.
* The 0.5 EFTSL of research training must have included at least 50% of research on a focused topic.
Additional requirements
You will need to demonstrate that your prior qualifications used as the basis for admission are in a discipline relevant to the proposed area of research – unless an exemption is approved by the Pro Vice Chancellor Graduate Research Training (or delegate).
Please note that admission to a research degree at Adelaide University is conditional on the availability of a suitable supervisory panel and resources to support the proposed project.
Recognition of prior learning
Adelaide University is committed to recognising the contribution of students’ prior learning towards their program requirements. Credit may be granted for formal, informal, and non-formal learning. Visit the Credit for previous study page for more information.
Answer a few simple questions with our online Credit Assessor to see what credit you could get.
English language entry requirements
Students who speak English as a second language must have obtained one of the following standards within the last two years prior to application.
IELTS Overall 6.5
IELTS Reading 6
IELTS Listening 6
IELTS Speaking 6
IELTS Writing 6
Please note some disciplines require a higher overall score of 7.0 with a minimum of 6.5 for each band, including: Education, Language and Literature, Communication and Media Studies, and Philosophy and Religious Studies.

Why Doctor of Philosophy?
Transform ideas into real-world impact with our flagship research degree.
Every breakthrough discovery begins with curiosity – a question, challenge or unique problem that sparks a drive to explore and solve. Often, these innovations begin with people like you – those who push the boundaries of knowledge to create meaningful change.
New knowledge drives progress in society, the economy and industry. The researchers behind these discoveries are essential across all disciplines – from the creative arts and healthcare to education, social work and beyond. Their work fuels innovation, inspires social change and establishes best practices across all aspects of our lives.
A Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) is a distinguished academic qualification and Adelaide University’s flagship research degree. Whether you aspire towards a research-focused career in academia or a role in industry underpinned by research expertise, this degree empowers you to deepen your knowledge, break new ground, and contribute something unique to our world.
Overview
Become a thought leader and change maker by studying a PhD at Adelaide University. Your degree will allow for a thriving career, where your research experience is respected and rewarded by industry and academia alike.
A PhD is an investment in yourself as an innovator and a leader – and it’s the essential qualification for those aspiring towards a research-focused career in the private or public sector, or academia.
Adelaide University attracts world-leading researchers who will mentor and supervise you throughout your PhD journey. With their support, you’ll undertake an independent project on a topic that’s both meaningful to you and significant to your field.
A PhD is a self-directed degree that does not involve classes or coursework. Instead, you’ll complete progress milestones. Your studies will culminate in a substantial thesis or creative project and exegesis that offers an original contribution to your discipline, and an oral examination of your thesis or creative work and exegesis before a panel of examiners.
Throughout this process, you’ll gain expertise in independent research, apply creative thinking to tackle complex challenges, and refine your ability to communicate intricate ideas to diverse audiences.
We understand that balancing study with work, family responsibilities and other important commitments can be challenging. It's why we’ve designed our program to be flexible. Where possible, you can choose to study full-time or part-time, helping you pursue your study goals without forgoing your current commitments.
Discover our research pathways
Are you an experienced professional looking to upskill your research abilities? Perhaps you’re looking for a clear pathway to a PhD? Maybe you didn’t meet the entry requirements for the Master of Research? Our research-focused Graduate Certificates can help you take the next step towards your goals – whether that’s advancing your career or working towards a research qualification. Learn more about our Graduate Certificate in Research Skills and Graduate Certificate in Research Design.
Key features
Conduct an original research project in your area of interest under the supervision of our world-class researchers.
Domestic students can complete this PhD program with no tuition fees and scholarships are available. Scholarships and fee waivers are available for eligible international students.
Explore a range of methodologies and approaches to research and produce a substantial thesis, or creative work and exegesis.
Build transferable skills in resilience, communication, independence, discovery, critical thinking, innovation, and self-discipline.
Expand your professional network by attending events such as conferences and forums.
Graduate with the advanced expertise required for a career underpinned by research expertise.
What you'll learn
A research degree is an advanced program of study that enables you to investigate a topic of interest in a deep and focused way. It is a challenging and rigorous program of study where you’ll learn how to tackle complex intellectual, creative and practical challenges and to effectively communicate your findings.
A PhD unlocks a world of opportunities – whether you aim to become a recognised authority in your field, pursue specialised or high-paying roles in your current industry or make a meaningful impact by translating research into actionable policies and practices.
Guided by leading researchers, your PhD will enhance your analytical thinking and help you master advanced research methodologies. You’ll conduct independent research that generates new insights and addresses challenges in your discipline. Additionally, you’ll develop vital communication skills, gaining the confidence to present your findings to both expert and general audiences. Throughout your journey, Adelaide University will support you in showcasing your work in academic publications, conferences and a broad range of other community-facing forums.
Scholarships available for domestic students
All domestic students accepted into the Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) program at Adelaide University will receive a tuition-free place for up to four years for a PhD program (or part-time equivalent) – effectively exempting domestic students from paying tuition during this period. Domestic students are also eligible to apply for Adelaide University Research Scholarships.
Scholarships available to international students
International students are eligible to apply for Adelaide University Research Scholarships. International students who are successful in being awarded a living allowance scholarship will also receive a tuition fee waiver.
Why Adelaide University?
Adelaide University is a future-focused university that combines the strengths of our two founding institutions, the University of South Australia and the University of Adelaide. We deliver nation-leading curriculum and student experience, remove barriers to education, and foster a culture of world-class research excellence.
At Adelaide University, we’re focused on delivering future-making research of scale and focus that can drive discovery, innovation and knowledge-based transformation for South Australia and beyond. Through our vibrant partnerships, we collaborate effectively to create lasting and transformative change.
Our research is grouped in the following five signature research themes:
Creative & Cultural
Defence & National Security
Food, Agriculture & Wine
Personal & Societal Health
Sustainable Green Transition.
With a presence that spans several metropolitan and three regional campuses, Adelaide University is an integral part of the South Australian landscape. The success of our communities – near and far, local and international – is at the heart of everything we do.
To you, we offer the scale, world-class disciplines, facilities, people and connections to launch you into your future.
Program Learning Outcomes
Upon successful completion of this program, you will be able to:
Exhibit the capacity to undertake original research independently.
Demonstrate expert research-based knowledge in a specialised field, with a comprehensive grasp of global perspectives.
Critically evaluate and synthesise research outputs, including prior work in your field, using analytical and creative thinking.
Design and adapt research methodologies suited to your specialised field, generating significant new knowledge and/or innovations.
Solve complex problems with logical, critical and creative thinking.
Work autonomously and collaboratively while exercising intellectual independence.
Uphold the highest ethical standards and demonstrate social responsibility in your research and professional practice.
Effectively communicate complex concepts to diverse audiences.
Demonstrate a capacity to apply the outcomes of research for social, cultural, environmental, and/or economic impact.
Completion requirements
To be awarded the degree of Doctor of Philosophy, you must complete:
1. The University’s program of transferable skills development
2. all applicable probation and progress milestones
3. a substantial thesis or creative work and exegesis, and
4. an oral examination of a research thesis or of a research creative work and related exegesis.

Career outcomes
A PhD equips you with advanced skills for long-term success in industry, public service, academia, and beyond. You’ll gain exceptional critical and creative thinking abilities, enabling you to tackle complex challenges and thrive in your career.
You might decide to pursue a career as a university academic, where you can further knowledge in your field while mentoring the next generation of researchers. Alternatively, you could take on a senior role in a private enterprise, driving innovation and solving global challenges. Or perhaps you’ll work in the public sector, creating a safer and more equitable society by translating cutting-edge research into evidence-based policy and practice.
With a research degree, you’ll unlock opportunities in fields such as:
Healthcare and clinical research
Education and academia
Information technology and data science
Government and policy research
Scientific research and development
Consulting services
Environmental science and sustainability
Finance and economics
Creative practice.
Industry trends
Employers across various sectors are increasingly looking for candidates with higher qualifications to fill specialised positions (World Economic Forum, 2023). With the advanced analytical, creative, and problem-solving abilities that come with a research degree, your abilities will be in high demand.
Likewise, advanced qualifications are associated with higher salaries and better employment outcomes. On average, Australians with postgraduate qualifications earn an additional $25,000 AUD annually when compared to those with only undergraduate qualifications. Those with postgraduate research degrees also report median salaries reaching $100,000 AUD (QILT Graduate Outcomes Survey, 2023).

Your study experience and support
Adelaide University sets you up for success in your studies – and your social life. You’ll have access to work placement and internship opportunities, overseas study tours and exchanges, networking events with guest speakers and more. Our campuses are equipped with purpose-built facilities including lecture theatres, libraries, workshops, laboratories, and spaces that simulate real work environments. These are all supported by the latest technologies and a 24/7 online learning platform with personalised study information and resources.
You’ll have everything you need to live well and thrive during your studies, with health services on campus, gymnasiums, technology zones and modern student lounges. Get involved in campus sport or join our student clubs that will connect you to your passions – and the people who share them.
Adelaide also has a variety of accommodation options to suit your individual requirements and budget, with options ranging from dedicated student accommodation to private rentals. One of the world’s most liveable cities, Adelaide has lots of leafy parks, gardens and social hubs – and some of the highest living standards globally. No matter where you are in Adelaide, you’re only a short distance from beaches, vineyards, museums, art galleries, restaurants, bars and parklands. Visit the accommodation web page to find out more.
Student services
We’re here to support you on your student journey. Adelaide University offers a range of support services and facilities, including:
Career advice and mentoring services
Personal counselling
LGBTQIA+ support
Academic support
Fees and finance help
Security services
Accommodation services
Common rooms
Prayer rooms.
You’ll also have unlimited access to our dedicated student support hub. Visit in-person or online, or contact our friendly team by phone. We can assist you with anything study-related including enrolment, identification cards, timetables, fees and more.
